title: skills_config
description: Configuration schema for the leafcutter agent/skill stack. Adopt by copying to .claude/skills_config.json in your project and editing values that differ from the defaults.

_comment.description: Human-readable note describing the config file purpose.

output_root.description: Folder name under target_root where build.py writes all outputs. Configurable per consumer project.

shim_strategy.description: How to bridge canonical tool paths (.claude/, .gemini/, etc.) to output_root. auto = symlink with copy fallback on PermissionError.

tickets_inbox_path.description: Root folder for standalone ticket files (00_inbox equivalent).

tickets_todo_path.description: Root folder for in-flight tickets and epics.

tickets_rejected_path.description: Root folder for rejected tickets (decided-against work, kept for history).

ticket_lifecycle_path.description: Path to the ticket_lifecycle.json manifest (generated by build.py into the target project).

tickets_rejected_path.description: Root folder for rejected tickets (decided-against work, kept for history).

ticket_lifecycle_path.description: Path to the ticket_lifecycle.json manifest (generated by build.py into the target project).

test_command_live_trader.description: Command to run the fast unit test suite (must complete in < 5s). Used by the commit agent pre-flight and the test-runner agent.
test_command_live_trader.default: poetry run python -m unittest discover -s unit_tests/live_trader -t . -p "test_*.py"

test_command_sql.description: Command to run the SQL/database integration tests (slow, requires running DB).

test_command_single_file_pattern.description: Pattern for running a single test file. Use <file> as placeholder.

precommit_autofix_config_path.description: Path to the precommit-autofix routing config JSON.

default_branch.description: Name of the default/main branch for PR targets and merge operations.

collector_enforcer_paths.description: List of path prefixes that trigger the collector-enforcer skill.

top_level_packages.description: List of top-level Python packages in the project. Used by import-scanner and blast-radius analysis.

test_output_dir.description: Directory for test output files. Must be outside the project root.

worktree_base_path.description: Parent directory for epic worktrees (relative to repo root, or absolute).

settings_module.description: Python module to verify after worktree bootstrap. Set to a module that exists in your project.

docs_root.description: Root directory for project documentation (relative to project root, with trailing slash). All docs-related paths in paths.json, commit guardian, and doc compliance derive from this value.

changelog_folder.description: Folder where per-entry changelog Markdown files are written.

changelog_categories_path.description: Path to a Markdown file containing project-specific commit categorization rules. Read at runtime by changelog-agent Step 3. If the file does not exist, changelog-agent falls back to conventional-commit prefix heuristics only.

worktree_cleanup.description: Controls pre-removal process and log cleanup in the close-worktree flow.

kill_residual_processes.description: When true, background processes matching the worktree path are terminated before git worktree remove. When false, a summary is printed and the user must act manually.

log_globs.description: Glob patterns for log files to remove from the worktree directory before git worktree remove.

protected_paths.description: Path substrings — any process whose cmdline matches any entry aborts the cleanup instead of being killed. Use to protect production processes (e.g. live trader).

testing_context.description: Test infrastructure knowledge shared by test-planner, test-writer, and test-runner agents. Adopters customize this block to match their project's test layout.

test_root.description: Root directory containing all test subdirectories.

readme_path.description: Path to the primary test README (read by test-planner at runtime for directory layout, naming conventions, and performance constraints).

directories.description: Maps each test subdirectory name to its framework and DB-dependency flag. Used by test-planner to produce valid target_dir values and by test-writer to pick the correct setUp/tearDown pattern.

framework.description: Test framework used in this directory.

db_required.description: True if tests in this directory require a running database.

max_test_duration_seconds.description: Maximum allowed wall-clock duration for any auto-running test. Tests that exceed this limit must use the manual_test_suffix.

manual_test_suffix.description: Suffix appended to test function names that are excluded from the standard pre-commit suite (slow or DB-requiring tests).

db_connection_test.description: Connection string for the test database environment. Used in test setUp for DB-requiring tests.

naming_pattern.description: Glob pattern that test files must match.

test_output_rules.description: Human-readable reminder about test output constraints (never write to project dirs).
test_output_rules.default: Never write to project dirs; use tmp_path or %TEMP%
